thread.title: Zuckerberg Fires Back at Apple's Tim Cook, Defends Facebook's Business Model

author: thestreet.com
title: Zuckerberg Fires Back at Apple's Tim Cook, Defends Facebook's Business Model
text:
The war of words between Facebook Inc. ( FB ) CEO Mark Zuckerberg and Apple Inc.'s ( AAPL ) Tim Cook is heating up.
Last week, Cook called out Facebook for profiting off of its users' data, telling Recode and MSNBC that Apple has "elected not to do that" and criticizing Zuckerberg's handling of the Cambridge Analytica data scandal .
In response, Zuckerberg told Vox's Ezra Klein in a podcast released on Monday that Cook's comments were "extremely glib, and not at all aligned with the truth."
